segments.tts: The arena's empty. Now it's my time – Zam's night shift!
Fun fact: NHL ice is only about an inch thick.
An inch? That's as thick as me!
And it's not white – it's painted white. The lines too, under the ice!
I've been standing on paint this whole time?!
Back in my day, ice came from a pond. With a duck in it.
A new NHL rink takes almost two days, layer by layer.
Then I flood it with hot water – about sixty degrees Celsius.
Hot water melts in and freezes smoother. Science!
The first ice resurfacer? Built in 1949, in California.
